Name: Cafe Shed
Author: BethKitten
Description:
Sick and tried of how there is no Cafe to show off your baked goods?  Then let's turn the shed into a nice sized cafe with plenty of room to show case your goods plus have others over to relax and enjoy them.


This mod was created for mobile users but might work for the newer versions also, so give it a try if you want.  Furniture pictured is my own merging from several different country furniture mods found here on Nexus plus a few pieces found on Naver.  You can find the Nexus mods by searching for country furniture.  Do not ask about the Naver pieces as they can not be shared.

Walls and Floors can not be changed even though there are two sections, floor and wall, that you will have to edit to get everything matching.  You can find the flooring needed to do this in the mod Arhen's Beige Wood Tone Interior.  Unpack and look under the assets file for the walls and floor file.  Easily make your own modified mod for walls and floor by changing out the png file in another walls and floor mod you already have downloaded.  Personal, I really like Arthen's so I use it all the time.

Downloads.Description: Download with required mods, unzip into mods folder, and enjoy.  This is for the first shed only, not the big shed.
